examples.text: yo taṃ rūpamayaṃ vegaṃ sahatī'ti yo taṃ cakkhusamudde samosaṭaṃ rūpamayaṃ vegaṃ

60202.commentary: (NPt) samosaranti sabhāgato ca sabhāvato ca saṅgahaṃ gacchantī'ti attho.

examples.text: kūṭaṃ samosarantī'ti kūṭasamosaraṇā. kūṭasamugghātā'ti kūṭassa samugghātena.

tattha yāni nandiyāvaṭṭe naye cattāri padāni, tattha aṭṭhārasa mūlapadāni samosaranti. yathā kathaṃ, samatho ca alobho ca adoso ca asubhasaññā ca dukkhasaññā ca imāni kusalapakkhe pañca padāni samathaṃ bhajanti.
tassa hi pathavito yāva akaniṭṭhabrahmalokā nīl'ādiārammaṇaṃ samosarantaṃ paripuṇṇabhāvaṃ kātuṃ na sakko'ti
tapojigucchāya susaṃvut'atto, vācaṃ pahāya kalahaṃ janena, samosavajjā virato saccavādī, na hi nūna tādisaṃ karoti pāpan'ti.

60207.commentary: (MNa) samohan'ti vicikicchāsahagatañ'c'eva uddhaccasahagatañ'cā'ti duvidhaṃ. yasmā pana moho sabb'ākusalesu uppajjati, tasmā tāni'pi idha vaṭṭanti'y'eva. imasmiṃ'y'eva hi duke dvādasākusalacittāni pariyādiṇṇānī'ti.

examples.text: samohaṃ vā cittaṃ samohaṃ cittan'ti pajānāti, vītamohaṃ vā cittaṃ vītamohaṃ cittan'ti pajānāti
tass'etaṃ pāṭikaṅkhaṃ, na chandaṃ janessati na vāyamissati na vīriyaṃ ārabhissati tass'aṅgaṇassa pahānāya, so sarāgo sadoso samoho sāṅgaṇo saṃkiliṭṭhacitto kālaṃ karissati.
atthaṅ'gatassa na pamāṇam'atthi, yena naṃ vajjuṃ taṃ tassa n'atthi, sabbesu dhammesu samohatesu, samūhatā vādapathā'pi sabbe'ti.
ayaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, bhikkhu ukkhittapaligho iti'pi, samkiṇṇaparikkho iti'pi, abbūḷh'esiko iti'pi, niraggaḷo iti'pi, ariyo pannaddhajo pannabhāro visaṃyutto iti'pi.

60211.meaning1: who has filled the trench; who has covered the ditch
60211.commentary: (MNa) so hi punappunaṃ uppattikaraṇavasena parikkhipitvā ṭhitattā parikkhā'ti vuccati, ten'esa tassā saṃkiṇṇattā vikiṇṇattā saṃkiṇṇaparikkho'ti vutto.

examples.text: ayaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, bhikkhu ukkhittapaligho iti'pi, samkiṇṇaparikkho iti'pi, abbūḷh'esiko iti'pi, niraggaḷo iti'pi, ariyo pannaddhajo pannabhāro visaṃyutto iti'pi.
tiṇhaṃ govikantanan'ti kho, bhaginiyo, ariyāy'etaṃ paññāya adhivacanaṃ, y'āyaṃ ariyā paññā antarā kilesaṃ antarā saṃyojanaṃ antarā bandhanaṃ sañchindati saṅkantati sampakantati samparikantati.

sañchinditvā saṅkantitvā sampakantitvā samparikantitvā vidhunitvā bāhiraṃ cammakāyaṃ ten'eva cammena taṃ gāviṃ paṭicchādetvā kiñ'c'āpi so evaṃ vadeyya, tath'ev'āyaṃ gāvī saṃyuttā iminā'va cammenā'ti, atha kho sā gāvī visaṃyuttā ten'eva cammenā'ti.

60214.synonym: kampati, pariphandati, pavedhati, phandati, byathati, vikampati, vedhati, vedhatī, saṅkampati, sampavedhati, saṃkampati

examples.text: n'āhaṃ taṃ passāmi samaṇaṃ vā brāhmaṇaṃ vā, saṅghiṃ gaṇiṃ gaṇ'ācariyaṃ, api arahantaṃ sammāsambuddhaṃ paṭijānamānaṃ, yo mayā vādena vādaṃ samāraddho na saṅkampeyya na sampakampeyya na sampavedheyya, yassa na kacchehi sedā mucceyyuṃ.
ayañ'ca dasasahassī lokadhātu saṅkampi sampakampi sampavedhi appamāṇo ca oḷāro obhāso loke pāturahosi atikkamm'eva devānaṃ dev'ānubhāvaṃ.
yadā vipassī lok'aggo, āyusaṅkhāram'ossaji, pathavī sampakampittha, medanī jalamekhalā.

60216.commentary: (VVa) vātena sampakampitā'ti vātena samantato visesato kampitā calitā. atha vā vaṭaṃsakā vātadhutā, vātena sampakampitā'ti avāteritāpi vāteritāpi ye te vaṭaṃsakā kampitā, tesaṃ suyyati nigghoso'ti atthayojanā.

examples.text: atha kho te bhikkhū saṃviggā lomahaṭṭhajātā ekam'antaṃ aṭṭhaṃsu, acchariyaṃ vata, bho, abbhutaṃ vata, bho! nivātañ'ca vata ayañ'ca migāramātupāsādo gambhīranemo sunikhāto acalo asampakampī, atha ca pana saṅkampito sampakampito sampacālito'ti!
vaṭaṃsakā vātadhutā, vātena sampakampitā, tesaṃ suyyati nigghoso, tūriye pañc'aṅgike yathā.
seyyathā'pi, bhante, selo pabbato acchiddo asusiro ekagghano. atha puratthimāya ce'pi disāya āgaccheyya bhusā vātavuṭṭhi n'eva naṃ saṅkampeyya na sampakampeyya na sampavedheyya

puratthimāya ce'pi disāya āgaccheyya samaṇo vā brāhmaṇo vā vād'atthiko vādagavesī, vādam'assa āropessāmī'ti, taṃ vata sahadhammena saṅkampessati vā sampakampessati vā sampacālessati vā'ti, n'etaṃ ṭhānaṃ vijjati.

60218.meaning1: could make shake; could cause to tremble
60218.meaningLit: could cause to shake forward together

examples.text: seyyathā'pi, bhante, selo pabbato acchiddo asusiro ekagghano. atha puratthimāya ce'pi disāya āgaccheyya bhusā vātavuṭṭhi n'eva naṃ saṅkampeyya na sampakampeyya na sampavedheyya
atha kho āyasmā mahāmoggallāno tathārūpaṃ iddh'ābhisaṅkhāraṃ abhisaṅkhāsi yathā vejayantaṃ pāsādaṃ pād'aṅguṭṭhakena saṅkampesi sampakampesi sampavedhesi.

60220.meaningLit: caused to be shaken forward together

examples.text: atha kho te bhikkhū saṃviggā lomahaṭṭhajātā ekam'antaṃ aṭṭhaṃsu, acchariyaṃ vata, bho, abbhutaṃ vata, bho! nivātañ'ca vata ayañ'ca migāramātupāsādo gambhīranemo sunikhāto acalo asampakampī, atha ca pana saṅkampito sampakampito sampacālito'ti!

60221.grammar: pr, caus of saṃ pa √cal, trans (+acc)

examples.text: puratthimāya ce'pi disāya āgaccheyya samaṇo vā brāhmaṇo vā vād'atthiko vādagavesī, vādam'assa āropessāmī'ti, taṃ vata sahadhammena saṅkampessati vā sampakampessati vā sampacālessati vā'ti, n'etaṃ ṭhānaṃ vijjati.

60222.meaning1: very many; lots of; plentiful; abundant

examples.text: mandiyā nu kho sesi udāhu kāveyyamatto, atthā nu te sampacurā na santi, eko vivitte sayan'āsanamhi, niddāmukho kim'idaṃ soppase vā'ti.

60223.construction:
saṃ + pa + jānā + ya
sampajāna + ya

examples.text: sati ca sampajaññañ'ca, caraṇā nāgassa tepare, saddhāhattho mahānāgo, upekkhāsetadantavā.
saṃkilesikā c'eva dhammā pahīyissanti… pāmujjaṃ c'eva bhavissati pīti ca passaddhi ca sati ca sampajaññañ'ca sukho ca vihāro.

60224.meaning1: clearly aware; fully knowing; completely comprehending
60224.commentary: (ITIa) sampajāno'ti sattaṭṭhāniyena sampajaññena samannāgato. (ANa) sato sampajāno'ti satiyā ca ñāṇena ca samannāgato. idaṃ ubhayaṃ ālokasaññāya upakārakattā vuttaṃ.

examples.text: upekkhako tattha viharati sato sampajāno
mosavajje na nīyetha, sampajāno saṭhāni na kayirā, atha jīvitena paññāya, sīlabbatena n'āññam'atimaññe.
iti attahetu vā parahetu vā āmisakiñcikkhahetu vā sampajānamusā bhāsitā hoti. ayaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, puggalo gūthabhāṇī.

60226.meaning1: forming a clear perception (of); creating a clear impression (of); cultivating attention (while)
60226.commentary: (MNa) sampajānakārī hotī'ti sampajaññena sabbakiccakārī, sampajaññam'eva vā kārī.

examples.text: so abhikkante paṭikkante sampajānakārī ahosiṃ, ālokite vilokite sampajānakārī ahosiṃ, samiñjite pasārite sampajānakārī ahosiṃ, saṅghāṭipattacīvaradhāraṇe sampajānakārī ahosiṃ
sampajānapabbaṃ niṭṭhitaṃ.

60228.commentary: (ANa) sampajānamusā bhāsitā hotī'ti jānanto'y'eva musāvādaṃ kattā hoti.

examples.text: iti attahetu vā parahetu vā āmisakiñcikkhahetu vā sampajānamusā bhāsitā hoti. ayaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, puggalo gūthabhāṇī.

idh'āhaṃ, bhante, aḍḍakaraṇe nisinno passāmi khattiyamahāsāle'pi brāhmaṇamahāsāle'pi gahapatimahāsāle'pi aḍḍhe mahaddhane mahābhoge pahūtajātarūparajate pahūtavitt'ūpakaraṇe pahūtadhanadhaññe kāmahetu kāmanidānaṃ kām'ādhikaraṇaṃ sampajānamusā bhāsante.
sampajānamusāvāde pācittiyaṃ.
evaṃ parittakaṃ kho, rāhula, tesaṃ sāmaññaṃ yesaṃ n'atthi sampajānamusāvāde lajjā'ti.

idāni tīsu'pi dvāresu āyūhanacetanā samodhānetabbā. seyyath'idaṃ, kāyadvāre sayaṃkatamūlikā vīsati cetanā, āṇattimūlikā vīsati, sampajānamūlikā vīsati, asampajānamūlikā vīsatī'ti asīti cetanā honti, tathā vacīdvāre.

60231.meaning1: is aware (of); is alert (to); knows; perceives

examples.text: yaṃ kiñci sampajānāsi, uddhaṃ adho tiriyañ'cā'pi majjhe, etesu nandiñ'ca nivesanañ'ca, panujja viññāṇaṃ bhave na tiṭṭhe.

60232.meaning1: happens to be; turns out to be

examples.text: taṃ kiṃ maññasi, poṭṭhapāda, nanu evaṃ sante sappāṭihīrakataṃ bhāsitaṃ sampajjatī'ti? addhā kho, bhante, evaṃ sante sappāṭihīrakataṃ bhāsitaṃ sampajjatī'ti.
nanu evaṃ sante tesaṃ samaṇabrāhmaṇānaṃ appāṭihīrakataṃ bhāsitaṃ sampajjatī'ti?
suddhassa ve sadā phaggu, suddhass'uposatho sadā, suddhassa sucikammassa, sadā sampajjate vataṃ.
mudusamatale pana phāsuvihāraṃ āgamma kammaṭṭhānaṃ sampajjati.

te samaṇena gotamena dhammiyā kathāya sandassitā samādapitā samuttejitā sampahaṃsitā na c'eva samaṇaṃ gotamaṃ pañhaṃ pucchanti, kutossa vādaṃ āropessanti? añña'd'atthu samaṇasseva gotamassa sāvakā sampajjanti.
iti kho, puṇṇa, sampajjamānaṃ kukkuravataṃ kukkurānaṃ sahabyataṃ upaneti, vipajjamānaṃ nirayan'ti. evaṃ vutte, acelo seniyo kukkuravatiko parodi, assūni pavattesi.

tena kho pana samayena vajirapāṇi yakkho āyasaṃ vajiraṃ ādāya ādittaṃ sampajjalitaṃ sajotibhūtaṃ saccakassa nigaṇṭhaputtassa uparivehāsaṃ ṭhito hoti, sac'āyaṃ saccako nigaṇṭhaputto bhagavatā yāvatatiyaṃ sahadhammikaṃ pañhaṃ puṭṭho na byākarissati etth'ev'assa sattadhā muddhaṃ phālessāmī'ti.
varaṃ, bhikkhave, tattāya ayosalākāya ādittāya sampajjalitāya sajotibhūtāya cakkhu'ndriyaṃ sampalimaṭṭhaṃ, na tv'eva cakkhuviññeyyesu rūpesu anubyañjanaso nimittaggāho.

60239.meaning2: having succeeded, having prospered, having happened, having become

60241.commentary: (ANa) na sampajjhāyatī'ti asmimānavasena na sampajjhāyati. sesaṃ pāḷinayen'eva veditabbaṃ.

examples.text: ayaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, bhikkhu n'eva usseneti na paṭiseneti na dhūpāyati na pajjalati na sampajjhāyati.
tadahu pabbajito santo, jātiyā sattavassiko, so'pi maṃ anusāseyya, sampaṭicchāmi matthake.
yadetaṃ, mahārāja, tathāgato na bhaṇeyya, pattacīvaram'pi attano pariyādāpetvā bhikkhū buddhapūjaṃ y'eva kareyyun'ti. sādhu, bhante nāgasena, evam'etaṃ tathā sampaṭicchāmī'ti.
ekadivasaṃ mama parisāya vāro pāpuṇātu, ekadivasaṃ tava parisāya, vārappatto migo gantvā dhammagaṇḍikāya gīvaṃ ṭhapetvā nipajjatu, evaṃ sante migā kilantā na bhavissantī'ti. so sādhū'ti sampaṭicchi.
te, sādhū'ti sampaṭicchitvā, sumedhatāpaso iddhimā'ti jānantā udakabhinn'okāsaṃ sallakkhetvā, tvaṃ imaṃ ṭhānaṃ alaṅ'karohī'ti adaṃsu.

evam'pi piyāyitaṃ janan'ti. evan'ti opammasampaṭipādanaṃ. piyāyitaṃ janan'ti mamāyitaṃ janaṃ mātaraṃ vā pitaraṃ vā bhātaraṃ vā bhaginiṃ vā puttaṃ vā dhītaraṃ vā mittaṃ vā amaccaṃ vā ñātiṃ vā sālohitaṃ vāti, evam'pi piyāyitaṃ janaṃ.
yadā passāmi gopālakaṃ vā pasupālakaṃ vā tiṇahārakaṃ vā kaṭṭhahārakaṃ vā vanakammikaṃ vā, vanena vanaṃ gahanena gahanaṃ ninnena ninnaṃ thalena thalaṃ sampatāmi.

60254.meaning1: right now; at present; recently; soon after

examples.text: dhammatā esā, bhikkhave, sampatijāto bodhisatto samehi pādehi patiṭṭhahitvā uttar'ābhimukho sattapada-vītihārena gacchati setamhi chatte anudhāriyamāne, sabbā ca disā anuviloketi, āsabhiṃ vācaṃ bhāsati

60255.commentary: (DNa) sampatijāto'ti muhuttajāto. pāḷiyaṃ pana mātukucchito nikkhantamatto viya dassito, na evaṃ daṭṭhabbaṃ. nikkhantamattañ'hi naṃ paṭhamaṃ brahmāno suvaṇṇajālena paṭiggaṇhiṃsu, tesaṃ hatthato cattāro mahārājāno ajinappaveṇiyā, tesaṃ hatthato manussā dukūlacumbaṭakena. manussānaṃ hatthato muccitvā pathaviyaṃ patiṭṭhito.

examples.text: dhammatā esā, bhikkhave, sampatijāto bodhisatto samehi pādehi patiṭṭhahitvā uttar'ābhimukho sattapada-vītihārena gacchati setamhi chatte anudhāriyamāne, sabbā ca disā anuviloketi, āsabhiṃ vācaṃ bhāsati
eko uposatho sampatto, dve uposathā atikkantā, pañca uposathā avasiṭṭhā.
examples.source: VIN PAT PK saṅghuposatha pubbakaraṇādi vidhi

examples.text: so aparena samayena chātakabhaye sampatte yathānikkhittaṃ dhaññaṃ paribhuñjanto koṭṭhesu ca cāṭiādīsu ca nikkhittadhaññe parikkhīṇe parijane pakkosāpetvā āha.

60259.meaning1: abstention from (whatever morality) has been attained
60259.commentary: (MNa) yā pāṇ'ātipātā viramantassa, yā tasmiṃ samaye pāṇ'ātipātā ārati viratī'ti evaṃ vuttā kusalacittasampayuttā virati, sā bhedato tividho hoti sampattavirati samādānavirati samucchedaviratī'ti. tattha asamādinnasikkhāpadānaṃ attano jātivayabāhusacc'ādīni paccavekkhitvā ayuttaṃ amhākaṃ evarūpaṃ kātun'ti sampattavatthuṃ avītikkamantānaṃ uppajjamānā virati sampattaviratī'ti veditabbā sīhaḷadīpe cakkanaupāsakassa viya.

examples.text: tattha yā kulaputtassa attano jātiṃ vā kulaṃ vā gottaṃ vā paṭicca, na me etaṃ patirūpaṃ, yv'āhaṃ imaṃ pāṇaṃ haneyyaṃ, adinnaṃ ādiyeyyan'ti-ādinā nayena sampattavatthuto virati, ayaṃ sampattavirati nāma.
etasmiṃ ṭhāne mahāsampatti hoti, bodhisattaṃ parivāretvā nisinnā dhātiyo rañño sampattiṃ passissāmā'ti antosāṇito bahi nikkhantā.

60262.meaning2: achievement (one of the 2 kinds of rasa)

examples.text: lakkhaṇ'ādīsu ca tesaṃ tesaṃ dhammānaṃ sabhāvo vā sāmaññaṃ vā lakkhaṇaṃ nāma, kiccaṃ vā sampatti vā raso nāma, upaṭṭhān'ākāro vā phalaṃ vā paccupaṭṭhānaṃ nāma, āsannakāraṇaṃ padaṭṭhānaṃ nāma.

60265.meaning1: what is called a state of good fortune

examples.text: sace kho tvaṃ, bhikkhu, brahmuno vacanaṃ upātivattissasi, seyyathā'pi nāma puriso siriṃ āgacchantiṃ daṇḍena paṭippaṇāmeyya… evaṃ sampadam'idaṃ, bhikkhu, tuyhaṃ bhavissati.
evaṃsampadam'idaṃ āyasmantānaṃ satthari sammukhībhūte, taṃ bhagavantaṃ atisitvā, amhe etam'atthaṃ paṭipucchitabbaṃ maññatha
sahā'v'assa dassanasampadāya, tayassu dhammā jahitā bhavanti, sakkāyadiṭṭhi vicikicchitañ'ca, sīlabbataṃ vā'pi yadatthi kiñci.
iti kho, bhikkhave, na'y'idaṃ brahmacariyaṃ lābhasakkārasilok'ānisaṃsaṃ na sīlasampad'ānisaṃsaṃ na samādhisampad'ānisaṃsaṃ na ñāṇadassan'ānisaṃsaṃ
evaṃsampadam'idaṃ āyasmantānaṃ satthari sammukhībhūte, taṃ bhagavantaṃ atisitvā, amhe etam'atthaṃ paṭipucchitabbaṃ maññatha
yo yajati tividhaṃ yaññasampadaṃ, ārādhaye dakkhiṇeyyebhi tādi, evaṃ yajitvā sammā yācayogo, upapajjati brahmalokan'ti brūmī'ti.

60269.commentary: (NIDD1a) cakkhusampadā'ti cakkhussa sampadā. mayhaṃ cakkhu sampannaṃ maṇivimāne ugghāṭitasīhapañjaraṃ viya khāyatī'ti uppannaṃ sukh'assādaṃ sandhāya cakkhusampadā'ti vuttaṃ. sotasampad'ādīsu'pi es'eva nayo.

examples.text: cha bhavasātāni, cakkhusampadā, sotasampadā, ghānasampadā, jivhāsampadā, kāyasampadā, manosampadā.

60270.meaning1: handing down; handing over; passing on (scriptures)

examples.text: etha tumhe, kālāmā, mā anussavena, mā param'parāya, mā itikirāya, mā piṭakasampadānena, mā takkahetu, mā nayahetu, mā ākāraparivitakkena, mā diṭṭhinijjhānakkhantiyā, mā bhabbarūpatāya, mā samaṇo no garū'ti.
vinayāyā'ti vinayena. karaṇ'atthe hi idaṃ sampadānavacanaṃ.
vinayāyā'ti vinayena. karaṇ'atthe hi idaṃ sampadānavacanaṃ.

60275.meaning1: having torn through; having ripped apart; having burst through

examples.text: ye'pi te, bhikkhave, rañño nāgā gāmanigamarājadhānīsu, daḷhehi varattehi baddhā, te'pi tāni bandhanāni sañchinditvā sampadāletvā bhītā muttakarīsaṃ cajamānā, yena vā tena vā palāyanti.
seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, saradasamaye kassako mahānaṅgalena kasanto sabbāni mūlasantānakāni sampadālento kasati

60281.meaning2: having torn, having split, having burst open

examples.text: tass'eva kho pana pubbe aviddasuno āghāto hoti byāpādo sampadoso. sv'āssa pahīno hoti ucchinnamūlo tāl'āvatthukato anabhāvaṃkato āyatiṃ anuppādadhammo.
seyyathā'pi nāma phālo divasasantatto udake pakkhitto cicciṭāyati ciṭiciṭāyati sandhūpāyati sampadhūpāyati, evam'eva so habyaseso udake pakkhitto cicciṭāyati ciṭiciṭāyati sandhūpāyati sampadhūpāyati
tassa sīghena javena dhāvato chavim'pi ḍayhati, cammam'pi ḍayhati, maṃsam'pi ḍayhati, nhārum'pi ḍayhati, aṭṭhīni'pi sampadhūpāyanti, ubbhataṃ tādisam'eva hoti.
atha kho so pāyaso udake pakkhitto cicciṭāyati ciṭiciṭāyati sandhūmāyati sampadhūmāyati.
seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, kiṭṭhaṃ sampannaṃ. kiṭṭh'ārakkho ca pamatto, goṇo ca kiṭṭh'ādo aduṃ kiṭṭhaṃ otaritvā yāva'd'atthaṃ madaṃ āpajjeyya pamādaṃ āpajjeyya.
seyyathā'pi, gahapati, gāmassa vā nigamassa vā avidūre tibbo vanasaṇḍo. tatr'assa rukkho sampannaphalo ca upapannaphalo ca, na c'assu kānici phalāni bhūmiyaṃ patitāni.

60294.commentary: (VINa) kassa sampannaṃ na manāpan'ti sampattiyuttaṃ kassa na piyaṃ.

examples.text: kathañ'hi nāma samaṇā sakyaputtiyā sūpam'pi odanam'pi attano atthāya viññāpetvā bhuñjissanti! kassa sampannaṃ na manāpaṃ! kassa sāduṃ na ruccatī'ti!

60296.meaning1: accomplished in what is skilful; consummate in the good

examples.text: ekam'antaṃ nisinnaṃ kho pañcak'aṅgaṃ thapatiṃ uggāhamāno paribbājako samaṇamuṇḍikāputto etadavoca, catūhi kho ahaṃ, gahapati, dhammehi samannāgataṃ purisapuggalaṃ paññapemi sampannakusalaṃ paramakusalaṃ uttamapattipattaṃ samaṇaṃ ayojjhaṃ.

60297.commentary: (ANa) sampannakolakan'ti sampannabadaraṃ. sūkaramaṃsan'ti madhurarasehi badarehi saddhiṃ jīrak'ādisambhārehi yojetvā pakkaṃ ekasaṃvaccharika-sūkaramaṃsaṃ.

examples.text: sammukhā m'etaṃ, bhante, bhagavato sutaṃ sammukhā paṭiggahitaṃ, manāpadāyī labhate manāpan'ti. manāpaṃ me, bhante, sampannakolakaṃ sūkaramaṃsaṃ, taṃ me bhagavā paṭiggaṇhātu anukampaṃ upādāyā'ti. paṭiggahesi bhagavā anukampaṃ upādāya.
